notes.subject: warap na i go daun
notes.rationale: מוג i min 'sump o smel smel i pinis' — graun i olsem ais i smel; Tok Pisin i tanim 'warap na i go daun' olsem piksa bilong pworog.

notes.subject: mi strongim stret
notes.rationale: תכן i min 'makim/balansim long skelim' (wok bilong karpento); KJV 'mi holimap ol pol' — Tok Pisin i putim strong bilong holim.

notes.subject: סלה
notes.rationale: Sela — mak bilong miusik (stap o pause); em i stap olsem Hibru, no tanim.

translation: Graun i warap na i go daun, wantaim ol manmeri ol i save stap long en; mi yet mi strongim stret ol pol bilong en. Sela.
